Package com.nexuslink.protocol.redis

Class RedisService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.redis.RedisService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class RedisService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Redis client over Lettuce. Connect with a redis://[:password@]host:port[/db] (or rediss:// for TLS) URI, browse keys, read typed values, and run commands from a console.

Also speaks the two multi-node topologies (see RedisTopology): a redis-sentinel:// URI is parsed by Lettuce natively, and our own redis-cluster://h1:6379,h2:6379 seed-list scheme opens a RedisClusterClient. The command surface is the same in every mode because the field is typed to RedisClusterCommands — the common supertype that both standalone RedisCommands and RedisAdvancedClusterCommands extend.

    • execute

      public String execute(String commandLine)
      Runs one console command line against the server and renders the reply.

      The command is dispatched generically rather than matched against a list we maintain: the argument list goes to the server as typed, and the server decides what it accepts. That is the only way a console can be correct across versions and flavours — GETDEL exists from 6.2, FUNCTION from 7.0, OBJECT FREQ only under an LFU policy, JSON.SET and FT.SEARCH only with the Redis Stack modules loaded, and managed services block CONFIG and DEBUG outright. An unknown command comes back as the server's own error, which says far more than a client-side "not supported" ever could.

      Returns:
      the reply rendered as text, or ERR … with the server's message
